decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the new main-board power-button connector, its PWRON source, and its panel placement.
A same-message MODIFY already adds the panel power-button connector, updates the JST count, and extends the connector-destination inventory.
The new connector only taps the existing PWRON line on the main board; it does not change the interboard signal connector, its pinout, or the separate-link architecture.
Relocating the panel-button connector does not change the board-chain order, supplied rails, or main-board power-forwarding behavior.
The panel power-button connection is unrelated to I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cable-length constraints.
The PWRON button tap does not alter addressable-LED supply voltage, GPIO-controlled power, LED selection, or data-level shifting.
The relocated panel power-button connector does not change the battery-charge indicator, CHGLED connector, or associated component values.
The source changes only the panel-button connector location and wiring tap; it does not answer or modify the separate DCDC1 output-voltage requirement.
Adding a PWRON tap does not change the Schottky OR-ing method, power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The panel-button connector does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or the scope powered during standalone operation.
The panel-button relocation does not affect the battery connector, its pinout, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 battery connection.
The new connector taps the existing PWRON interboard signal and introduces no ESP32 GPIO assignment or reassignment.
